items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: Then Ravel, Bartok. The moderns, at the beginning, were the people that really stirred me up, that really got me thinking.

ctx.x: classical music mostly, the moderns. I was listening--discovering Stravinsky was a big thing for me. When I first heard his music I really flipped out. I loved the way he wrote. Then Ravel, Bartok. The moderns, at the beginning, were the people that really stirred me up, that really got me thinking.

As the years went by, I went backwards in terms of listening to composers. I got back to Bach, Beethoven, Mozart, and for the first time really appreciated them. But I had to hear the moderns first in order to appreciate the classics.
